thread:
Sana Ortiz: Quick one  we need a compact asset bundle for next week's webinar. Ask: one hero slide (two headline choices), three small metric cards, social crops, and a one-slide 'lead-handling' diagram. Low-fi comps are fine.

Riley (design-ops): I can deliver initial frames in 36 hours. What exact metrics & any strict copy rules?

Eli (growth): Metrics: latency p95, estimated unit cost per 1k tokens, and reliability (SLA target). Headline A: "Reduce inference spend, keep latency tight" Headline B: "Predictable LLM latency for prod"

Marta (demand): Social sizes: IG 1080x1080, LinkedIn 1200x627, Twitter 1200x675. For paid creative we need muted background + white overlay copy and a short 3-frame GIF (max 2s). Motion layers in Figma please.

Riley (design-ops): Noted. Figma file I'll use: https://www.figma.com/file/seedpack/launch-assets (dropping frames to marketing/launch). Export specs: hero 1920x1080, tiles 1080x1080 & 1200x627, PNG@2x + SVG + PPTX.

Sana Ortiz: Copy drafts (soften per legal):
- Latency: "p95 latency about 20-30ms (typical)"
- Cost: "Unit cost about $0.10 / 1k tokens (typical)"
- Reliability: "Target SLA 99.9%"
Landing: /events/webinar-register (gated).
Routing rule example: if work_email && company_size >= 250 -> enterprise_queue else inbound_queue.

Legal Bot: Quick compliance note: avoid absolute promises (no hard guarantees on price or latency). Use qualifiers like "typical" or "about". Required privacy line for gated forms: "By registering you consent to communications from Redwood Inference. See https://redwood.com/privacy." Tag me in Figma comments for signoff.

Riley (design-ops): Will swap wording to "typical". Accessibility: primary color #0A74FF; accent #0B6FD8; bg #F4F7FB. Contrast target >=4.5:1. Headers 22px semibold, body 14px. Will include dark-mode variants.

Eli (growth): Also include two short subheads (<=25 chars) for social overlays and one short CTA variant: "Register & get the playbook".

Marta (demand): For routing slide, map fields: CTA -> form (work email?) -> tag assignment -> queue -> notify channel (#leads-webinar). CSV export note: ts,email,company,company_size,route_tag. Ops will want that column list.

Riley (design-ops): Plan: 36h first-pass PNGs + Figma frames, then iterate after copy/legal signoff. Optional GIF if motion time allows. Checklist I'll attach in the Figma page: hero x2, 3 tiles, social exports, routing slide, alt text + localization (EN/FR/DE), export package.

Sana Ortiz: Sweet. Owners: Riley = design, Eli = messaging, Marta = paid, Legal Bot = compliance. Ping this thread when frames are live and I'll route to partners. :rocket:
